analysis.title: Tau × amyloid microglia study
analysis.summary: Mouse 2×2 design: MAPTKI, P301S, NLGF_MAPTKI, NLGF_P301S. Three assays: snRNA-seq pseudobulk, GeoMx spatial, bulk TiO2 proteomics + phosphoproteomics.
analysis.source: Hand-written prototype fixture. Structure + wording are drawn from veriformatics studies/naoto docs (CONTRACT.md, PROOF_SCOPE.md, case-study.md, publication-review, annotation-audit-findings). No data. Statuses reflect those docs, not a live check.

questions.text: Does mutant humanized tau (P301S) change the microglial response to amyloid (NLGF)?
Do the assays and measurement layers agree on the amyloid response?
Which phosphoproteomic results can be published?
Is there a tau- or amyloid-modulated proliferative microglia state?

obligations.text: The five named contrasts, including the interaction sign, compile exactly into factorial coefficients.
obligations.evidence: assurance/ContrastProof.lean: compile_preserves_estimand, canonical_estimands (13 theorems, standard axioms only)

obligations.text: Every supported fit uses a contrast matrix that matches the contract.
obligations.evidence: assurance/ProductionChecker.lean accepted_sound, invoked by R/core/design.R::assert_fit_identity at 5 fit entry points

obligations.text: A human confirms the contrast table is the intended biological question on each model's scale.
obligations.evidence: CONTRACT.md: human semantic review pending

obligations.text: limma/voom fits compute the estimates, standard errors and p-values correctly.
obligations.evidence: 18 baseline/estimand fixtures on synthetic data; no full-data rerun

obligations.text: Each snRNA library is one distinct, unpooled animal (together_NWR04 included).
obligations.evidence: User directive: treat together_NWR04 like the rest of the samples

obligations.text: Model assumptions hold: voom mean-variance trend, empirical-Bayes moderation, independence of preparations.
obligations.evidence: Not assessed

obligations.text: The multiple-testing family for FDR is defined per contrast and matches the reported tables.
obligations.evidence: case-study.md: next bounded contract, needs a statistical specification

obligations.text: The genotype difference is causal for the microglial phenotype (no confound from sex, batch or preparation).
obligations.evidence: Observational group comparison; sex assigned by batch

obligations.text: GeoMx and snRNA microglia measure the same estimand.
obligations.evidence: GeoMx selected plaque-contacting microglia in NLGF lines; snRNA keeps all microglia

obligations.text: Ensembl IDs (snRNA) map to gene symbols (GeoMx) through the validated symbol_map.
obligations.evidence: Cache symbol_map validated; mapping not proved

obligations.text: Assays use distinct animals, so only group-level comparison is valid.
obligations.evidence: User-reported design fact

obligations.text: Protein-group and phosphosite data come from the same 16 samples, matched by sample key.
obligations.evidence: User-reported design fact; key equality across both layers verified

obligations.text: Each phosphosite maps to the correct parent protein group.
obligations.evidence: Parent-protein averaging exists (Figure 8); mapping not checked

obligations.text: The result does not depend on restricted MAPTKI phosphoproteomic measurements.
obligations.evidence: Publication restriction; MAPTKI weights -1, -1, +1 in tau_alone, nlgf_in_maptki, interaction

obligations.text: nlgf_in_p301s and tau_in_nlgf have zero direct MAPTKI weight.
obligations.evidence: assurance/ContrastProof.lean: canonical_compilation

obligations.text: Shared filtering, residual variance and moderation leave nlgf_in_p301s and tau_in_nlgf independent of MAPTKI values.
obligations.evidence: publication-review: prevalence filter + eBayes use all four genotypes

obligations.text: The owner confirms the restriction covers MAPTKI-derived values only, not every phosphosite output.
obligations.evidence: Restriction scope needs clarification

obligations.text: Protein-group proteomics is a separate measurement from the restricted phosphosite data.
obligations.evidence: Source comments call both the same TiO2 assay

obligations.text: Cluster 2 is a coherent cycling (proliferative) microglia population.
obligations.evidence: Annotation audit: 99.22% of 4,366 cells detect none of five proliferation markers; label depends on Stmn1 alone

obligations.text: Cluster-2 fractions are computed per preparation from the recorded labels.
obligations.evidence: scripts/verify_annotation_aggregates.py

obligations.text: Sex and batch effects can be separated from genotype.
obligations.evidence: snRNA sex assigned by batch (01/03 male, 02/04 female)

claims.question: Q1
claims.text: The interaction contrast measures how P301S tau changes the amyloid response.

claims.question: Q1
claims.text: P301S tau amplifies the microglial transcriptional response to amyloid (interaction FDR < 0.05, snRNA pseudobulk).

claims.question: Q1
claims.text: Mutant tau causes microglia to fail to respond to amyloid plaques.

claims.question: Q2
claims.text: Amyloid responses of plaque-contacting microglia (GeoMx) match those of all snRNA microglia.

claims.question: Q2
claims.text: At group level, nlgf_in_p301s effect directions agree between snRNA and GeoMx for shared genes.

claims.question: Q2
claims.text: Each contrast compares genotype groups within one assay; no animal is paired across assays.

claims.question: Q2
claims.text: For P301S and NLGF lines, phosphosite changes can be normalized to parent-protein changes within the same animals, separating phosphorylation from protein abundance.

claims.question: Q3
claims.text: Phosphosite results for tau_alone, nlgf_in_maptki and interaction can be published.

claims.question: Q3
claims.text: Phosphosite results for nlgf_in_p301s and tau_in_nlgf can be published.

claims.question: Q3
claims.text: Protein-group proteomics results are not covered by the phosphosite restriction.

claims.question: Q4
claims.text: A proliferative microglia population is depleted in NLGF_P301S mice.

claims.question: Q4
claims.text: Cluster 2 makes up 0.87–4.27% of each NLGF_P301S preparation and 58.80–67.72% of three MAPTKI preparations.

claims.question: Q4
claims.text: Genotype changes the cluster-2 fraction independently of sex and batch.

sentences.text: We defined the tau × amyloid interaction as the difference of amyloid effects between P301S and MAPTKI mice.
sentences.rewrite: We defined the tau × amyloid interaction as (NLGF_P301S − P301S) − (NLGF_MAPTKI − MAPTKI). Its contrast algebra is proved; its match to the biological question awaits review.

sentences.text: P301S tau significantly amplified the microglial response to amyloid.
sentences.rewrite: We report interaction estimates as exploratory; spec review, numerical checks and model checks are pending, so no significance claim is made.

sentences.text: This shows that mutant tau drives microglial dysfunction around plaques.
Spatial profiling of plaque-contacting microglia confirmed the snRNA-seq findings.
sentences.rewrite: GeoMx profiled plaque-contacting microglia, a different population from snRNA-seq microglia, so the two assays are not directly compared.
Phosphoproteomic contrasts that depend on MAPTKI measurements are withheld under a publication restriction.

sentences.text: A proliferative microglia population was nearly absent in NLGF_P301S mice.
sentences.rewrite: Cluster 2, earlier labelled proliferative, is a heterogeneous group of uncertain identity; it made up 0.87–4.27% of NLGF_P301S preparations.

sentences.text: Cluster 2 made up 0.87–4.27% of NLGF_P301S preparations.
